subject: Charter Study Final Report
overview: The subcommittee reviewed remaining edits, layout formatting, and appendices for the committee's final charter report. Members set internal deadlines to compile the document ahead of the full committee's October meeting.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The subcommittee approved the minutes from July 29.

items.title: Final Report Compilation and Scheduling
items.summary: Members reviewed the inclusion of survey demographics, public comment links, and footnotes, and agreed on the document structure and formatting timeline before presenting the final report to the full committee.
